set.body:
Objective:
Implement DuckDB as an optional Frame engine adapter without changing the public Frame program or allowing DuckDB semantics to become the frontend contract.

Scope:
- Translate supported resolved logical plans and typed scalar functions to DuckDB relational operations or SQL.
- Register Frame Arrow inputs and consume Arrow result batches without row-object conversion.
- Initial execution requires complete plan support. Unsupported nodes, types, functions, null/overflow/order modes, or lifetime conditions fail during planning.
- Capability and explain output show translated plan, parameter bindings, Arrow handoffs, copies, and residual limitations.
- Engine selection is explicit; no silent local fallback.

Acceptance:
- Filter, projection, grouped aggregation, inner/left join, sort, limit, union, distinct, and the supported window subset pass differential tests against the local semantic reference.
- Null keys, null-safe equality, NaNs, timestamps, dictionaries, integer overflow policy, order guarantees, and floating reductions have documented conformance or typed rejection.
- Locally materialized Arrow batches register without CSV, JSON, or per-row conversion.
- Inputs and result streams retain valid owners for exactly the execution lifetime and close cleanly on success, failure, and early termination.
- DuckDB dependencies remain confined to the adapter module.
set.title: Frame adapter: DuckDB engine with Arrow handoff and semantic conformance
